$comment: Hand-labeled from the pinned sample source (scripts/samples.json), not from Concentrate output. Components: every .vue file under src/ outside tests (App.vue, src/components/, src/pages/), one script-setup or template component each, named after its file. Renders: every element in a template that renders a component of the repository, one label per element; <AppLink> renders src/components/AppLink.vue through app.component('AppLink', AppLink) in src/plugins/global-components.ts. RouterLink, RouterView and Suspense are library components. Pages: every route record in src/router.ts; lazy components (() => import('./pages/Home.vue')) count as the component the page renders. Calls: every call site in the listed files; generated API client methods (api.users.login) and Vue/Pinia functions stay unresolved, a destructured store action (updateUser) resolves to the setup store's function, and HttpClient.setSecurityData is a class field holding an arrow function. Class links (styleLinks): the static class="..." attributes and the string and object-key literals of :class in the .vue templates under src/, whose class public/main.css declares (index.html loads that stylesheet by a root-relative <link>, which is not a file import, so every link is a name match); found by a separate regex pass over the templates, not from Concentrate output. Class names the stylesheet does not declare (ion-*, auth-page, settings-page, align-left, space) and computed ones (:class="link.icon") are not labeled.
